ValidationRule.description: validation Rule To thrown An Error Message When Stage In opportunity Object Changes Other Then Prospecting If Product Is not created or existing and also Opportunity Is Not Closed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( IsClosed = false, CASE( TEXT(StageName),'Qualification', 1, 'Needs Analysis', 1,'Value Proposition',1,'Id. Decision Makers',1,'Perception Analysis',1,'Proposal/Price Quote',1,'Negotiation/Review',1,0) = 1, HasOpportunityLineItem = false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Opportunity Case can't Be Closed And Stage Can't Be changed From Prospecting If Product Is Not Created Or Existing
